name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Tranquility Barrel Sauna Canadian Timber 5 Person | CTC2345W
description: Description This Canadian Timber Tranquility Barrel Sauna with 18 in (45cm) Porch is handcrafted from beautiful Eastern White Cedar, which is strong for all-weather outdoor use, resistant to rot and decay, and features a beautiful light-colored finish. The door is 0.2 in (5mm) bronze tempered glass with a wooden frame and pre-hung on the front wall for easy installation. This Sauna kit comes with solid cedar cradles, and aluminum bands with stainless steel hardware and is packaged in a ready-to-assemble kit . This model features a built-in front porch with benches and 2 windows so you have a covered cool down area on the outside of the sauna. The round concept of the barrel sauna makes it unique and very efficient to heat as well as encourages proper air flow during sauna use. Features Seats: 4-5 people Cubic Size (Sauna Room): 360 ft³ ( 10.2³ ) Wood: Eastern White Cedar Walls: 1.5" thick solid Cedar Door: Full-Sized Door with Bronze-Tempered Window for Easy Access Weight: 1312 lbs Made in: Canada Exterior Dimensions: 86.25"W x 118"D x 86.25"H Shipping Dimensions: 120 x 45 x 34 What's Included? Full sauna kit: Pre-cut tongue & groove white cedar for full sauna structure 2x Solid benches 2x Bronze tempered glass windows Aluminum Bands Door w/ bronze tempered glass window Flat floor Porch with 2 seats Hardware Installation guide & video Heater sold separately Choose a matched heater package in the heater options on this page, or contact us if you'd like a different heater. Sauna Accessories Add a Cold Plunge Tub , Outdoor Shower , Backrests , Bucket & Ladle , Lights , Thermometer , and Sand Timer to create the ultimate relaxation haven.
